definitions.full: H4642. maashaqqah [ מַעֲשַׁקָּה ] noun feminine extortionate act ; — plural absolute מַעֲשַׁקּוֺת רַב Prov 28:16 great in extortions ; מ ׳בֶּצַע Isa 33:15 gain of extortions.
